# CIRC

> Computing Innovation & Research Club at Mama Ngina University College.

CIRC is a student-led technology community focused on practical computing, innovation, research, events, and peer learning.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Club overview, current activity, and highlights.
- [Communities](/communities): Technology communities and their focus areas.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming and past club events.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from CIRC activities.
- [Team](/team): Executive committee and community leads.
- [Join](/join): Membership application.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How personal information is handled.
- [Terms and conditions](/terms): Terms for using this website and club services.
- [Cookie policy](/cookies): Information about cookies and analytics.

The `/admin` and `/api` paths are private operational interfaces and should not be indexed.
